title.zh: 【Gate 推出一体化金融应用 Gate Money，并与 Visa 合作推出加密资产关联卡】
title.en: 【Gate 推出一体化金融应用 Gate Money，并与 Visa 合作推出加密资产关联卡】

current_state.zh: Gate launched Gate Money, an all-in-one app for holding crypto, stocks, gold and cash with card-based spending of any asset, and partnered with Visa to roll out a crypto-linked card across 40+ markets.
current_state.en: Gate launched Gate Money, an all-in-one app for holding crypto, stocks, gold and cash with card-based spending of any asset, and partnered with Visa to roll out a crypto-linked card across 40+ markets.
